note: v3744: Three backlog items (REG-2245/2247/2244). VAULT FIRST CLICK (#53, REG-2245): the fullscreen mule window is a body-level fixed overlay that switchTab never closed, so openMuleId and box.hidden survived a tab change and the next Vault open showed the stale SHARED card instead of the body (GrokBot tick 409). vaultCloseCard gains a silent arg; a switchTab wrapper closes any open card the instant the active tab changes; a hashchange listener closes it on Back and deep-links. ROSTER PUBLISHES THE STASH (#74, REG-2247, his 10-15 ruling): the roster only derived a stash from per-build cells (empty in his book), so his flat owned list never published; stash_rows_of now also yields the owned names and the stash read is lifted out of the characters branch into its own first-class section, same shape as vault. TOOLTIP WIRING GUARD (#42, REG-2244): the native-title suppression already shipped (REG-2116) but its only law called show directly and could never cover the real hover delegate; a new spec dispatches a real mousemove over a titled data-itip node and asserts both native titles are neutralised while the card is up and restored after. Also closed two already-shipped siblings: the #42 console half (REG-2116) and the #107 d2jsp price cache (REG-2216). HEART: three v3744 Routine-I spec.ts, RED-first; the roster spec drives the real python body-builder.
